POC ask / goals (summary):
- Workload: high-concurrency interactive chat + realtime reranking on product catalogs. Mix: 65% short-chat (<=128 tokens), 25% reranking (embeddings + rerank), 10% long-form summaries.
- Latency targets: p50 <= 40ms for short-chat inference; p95 <= 120ms. End-to-end SLA target for interactive UX: 150ms.
- Throughput target: sustained 700-900 reqs/sec in peak shopping events, bursts to 2k reqs/sec; average response size ~80 tokens.
- Cost sensitivity: target effective cost <$0.0015 per short-chat response (includes token + infra amortized).
- Model preference: prefer open models (Llama-3 family, Mistral) or Redwood-curated quantized variants. Want ability to route to smaller quantized variants under load.
- Optimize feature interest: intelligent batching (latency-aware), KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts, int8/int4 quantization profiles, model variant routing for graceful fallbacks.

- Run Redwood perf benchmark harness against their 50k synthetic traces (we provided sample traces). Deliverables: token-latency histogram, batching statistics, KV cache hit-rate, cost per 1M tokens, kernel selection notes.

- Security/compliance: require SOC2 Type II report and KMS integration details before procurement sign-off; data residency for EU customers (they have EU storefront).
